why: CI-WINDOWS-UNITTEST-SHARD-8-1: the heaviest measured windows classes run in the job repo-hygiene-python-windows-unittest-heavy, split into `parts` legs; the windows 7-way partition excludes exactly these. CI-WINDOWS-UNITTEST-HEAVY-PARTS-3-1: re-derived from hosted master logs the windows suite weighs 12047 s, more than the 9666 s that 7 shards and 2 parts hold at the 85 % limit, so parts went 2 -> 6 (5 cannot hold the open #705 and #709 additions) and the set was re-balanced so every shard and part is expected under that limit. LEASE-BATCH-PLAN-ARTIFACT-PREFLIGHT-1 r14: #705's 69 test_artifact_preflight_* cases (545.9 s hosted, run 40861273862) left VenueLeaseBatchLegPlanTests at 1131 s, past one part, so they run in their own class VenueLeaseBatchArtifactPreflightTests, which joins this set. CI-FLAKE-HEAVY-SLOT-GATE-UNIT-HOSTED-HANG-1 r16: BoundedCaptureIoTests (67 s hosted windows) joins, because the card's own growth took every shard to 1225.7 s against the 1224 s limit; it now sits at 1216.1 s and the heaviest part at 1206.7 s. test_ci_unittest_shard.HeavySetTests and ShardDurationBudgetTests pin both sides. HFR-NATIVE-60FPS-FULLRES-1 r20/r22: this PR's three conform classes (59.8 s hosted windows) are in this set; r22 re-added them on top of the HEADROOM-2 re-balance at the merge. CI-WINDOWS-UNITTEST-SHARD-HEADROOM-2: re-derived from seven green merge_group master runs (41906235113 .. 42029941982), with a class's row set to its largest per-run time rounded up to 0.1 s, the windows suite weighs 17510 s, past the 13962 s that 7 shards plus 6 parts hold at the 85 % limit (and past 1074 s per job with 60 s of headroom), so 17 more classes joined this set and parts went 6 -> 11; every shard now sits near 1008 s of weight and the heaviest part near 994 s. The timing tool now charges the gap before a docstring test (setUpClass) to its class and takes the shard tool's own SHARD_SLOWEST figure for every class that figure names, in place of the gap estimate. CI-SHARD-WEIGHTS-THERMAL-PARITY-CLASSES-1 r2: the 13 windows classes that r1 measured (the five AgentThresholdParity classes among them) took every shard to 1135 s against the 1074 s limit, so 8 more measured classes join this set (RepoHygieneTests, VenueQuietValidSampleTests, AppVerdictLatchPinTests, FootageStageJobTests, NoFixtureJobOfAnyBackendClamps, VisualCaptureGeneratorTests, AgentThresholdParityR4Tests, LookReceiptGeneratorTests); parts stay 11, every shard and part now sits at or under 1049 s.
